recompute_only: every rating byte from the committed r106 panel record (CORR-9: never re-scored, never re-run); zero LLM calls
domain_split_committed: the sealed rows' own question_type field (15 intervention-proposal / 15 predictor-design) — the within-domain normalization uses a committed field, not an invented clustering

normalization.formula: z = (x - median_domain_pooled) / (1.4826 * MAD_domain_pooled); MAD=0 domains degenerate to median-centering (typed)

agreement.metric: pairwise proportion agreement on the binarized votes (complete seat pairs)

gate_calibration.rule: a row FAILS iff its seat-mean robust-z sits more than 1 scaled-MAD below its domain median; the burned demo ACCEPTS iff no row fails AND the pooled mean z >= 0
gate_calibration.audit_anchor: the burned demo was ACCEPTED by the auditor R105 verdict at mean 3.90 (CORR-9); calibration_pass=true means the tightened gate reproduces that acceptance from committed bytes

honest_note: the agreement is measured on BINARIZED votes of an ordinal rubric — the within-domain normalization removes the cross-domain scale heterogeneity, not rater variance; a target-miss is typed, never tuned away
